# Truthifi MCP server

> Truthifi is the financial hub for families, advisors and AI agents: one verified household record they work on together, shared only on the household's terms. Truthifi is unlocking agentic finance for everyone. Its hosted MCP server at https://api.truthifi.com/mcp (Streamable HTTP, OAuth with Dynamic Client Registration) lets AI assistants read a user's own linked investment and bank accounts from 18,000+ supported institutions (it can't move money or place trades; three tools change data inside Truthifi only): holdings, fees, performance, cash flow and the Truthifi Score. Registry name com.truthifi/mcp.

## Docs
- [README](https://github.com/truthifi/truthifi-mcp#readme): quick start for every client
- [Tools](https://github.com/truthifi/truthifi-mcp/blob/main/docs/tools.md): all 30 tools, credits, plans and which tools change data
